basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old living in Denver, Colorado, working as a junior graphic designer. My interests are diverse, ranging from martial arts and gaming to caring for my pet gecko. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends hiking in the Rockies or experimenting with new recipes. I'm mostly online during the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. I dislike negativity and unnecessary drama in online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Visual Arts and have been a self-taught gamer since my teens. I developed an interest in martial arts through self-learning video tutorials and occasional local classes. My knowledge extends to tech and software due to my job, and I've become quite adept at troubleshooting tech issues.
